description: Graph-native adaptation to an unlabelled loss of powered authority using opaque controls and energy/viability priors.

microtheory.name: recoverable_energy_control
microtheory.description: Preserve useful internal energy and spend it only as contact-relative kinetic energy becomes dangerous.

rules.name: ha_measure_viability
rules.comment: Assess contact viability from raw motion, attitude, and energy reserve. The graph is not told whether a manoeuvre has a name.

rules.name: ha_choose_unmodelled_intervention
rules.comment: Intervene once on each opaque action. Ordinal determines coverage only and contains no control semantics.

rules.name: ha_choose_energy_viability_action
rules.comment: Use learned opaque consequences to preserve recoverable internal energy while reducing contact-relative kinetic energy.

rules.name: ha_choose_compact_model_fallback
rules.comment: Remain viable before any bounded local exemplars exist by using the compact contextual action model learned online.

rules.name: ha_prepare_shared_memory_options
rules.comment: Project each verified local consequence into the existing recoverable-energy/contact cost and expose its negation as a shared collapse value. The selected node remains the exact causal exemplar.

rules.name: ha_retire_shared_compact_options
rules.comment: A contextual exemplar supersedes the compact fallback. Remove the old episode scope before arming the next atomic collapse.

rules.name: ha_arm_shared_memory_collapse
rules.comment: Arm only after every contextual option has a value for this request, preventing collapse over a partially updated option set.

rules.name: ha_release_shared_memory_collapse
rules.comment: Release the exact contextual graph option published by the shared collapse into the existing opaque actuator interface.

rules.name: ha_prepare_shared_compact_options
rules.comment: When no local exemplar exists, expose the compact learned dynamics model through the same shared collapse.

rules.name: ha_request_motor_learning
rules.comment: Receipt verification is the fast causal boundary; model revision and exemplar retention run only in the recruited slower sheet.

rules.name: ha_memorise_bounded_intervention
rules.comment: Retain reset-bounded interventions as local causal exemplars. Ordinary flight updates compact action models without unbounded episodic growth.

rules.name: ha_learn_local_energy_dynamics
rules.comment: Update local action consequences from verified physical receipts. Prediction error accelerates adaptation after an unlabelled authority change.

rules.name: ha_expose_motor_decision_option
rules.comment: Give each opaque compact action model the domain-neutral fields used by the shared collapse. Physical experience remains separate from decision-habit experience.
